No implementation success is claimed ? these reproduce baseline defect observations and validate artifacts only.

## Gate baseline change ? verified

`git rev-parse HEAD` in this worktree returns `17998d8cb20bc44a9ca04113ea9236f9f9279e1a`, exactly the constant at `verify-artifacts.mjs:32`. So today `git diff <baseline>` is equivalent to `git diff HEAD`, and my rerun passes. The forward-looking property holds as described:

1. Committing the planning documents leaves them in `git diff baseline --name-only`, so the changed set stays non-empty and the line-42 empty-set control keeps meaning something ? the previous HEAD-relative version would have gone silent there.
2. An application file touched in any commit layered on top surfaces as a non-plan path and trips line 39.
3. Untracked scanning is retained (`git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z`, line 34), and all three failure controls call the real validators, not copies: `verifyLink` on a broken relative link (line 18), `verifyChanges` on a synthetic `src/canary.ts` (line 41) and on an empty set (line 42).

Two limits, neither a finding: the constant will need updating if the plan is rebased onto a newer main ? and if that commit is absent from the repo, `execFileSync` throws and the gate fails closed, which is the right direction; and because it compares trees, reverting a file to its baseline content shows nothing, which is not an edit-hiding vector.

`probe-baseline.mjs` is unchanged from round two (mtime 12:27) and I re-read it in full: the C16 price evidence at lines 82-88 with its fail-once control at line 85 is intact, as are the earlier positive controls at lines 38-39, 60-61 and 80.

## The five minors ? all closed

**R1 ? resolved, better than proposed.** PLAN:50 no longer carries a range at all: "reconcile all C01-C17 claims, preserving source/documentation-only findings as such and writing reproductions for each executable defect before its fix." That handles the documentation-only rows (C13-C15) explicitly instead of just widening a number, and adds a reproduce-before-fix requirement. PLAN:154 now reads "Recheck all C01-C17." No stale range remains in PLAN.md.

**R2 ? resolved, better than proposed.** PLAN:110 now reads "Crash/restart and overlapping dispatchers may execute work again but cannot duplicate a committed revision for the same job/event/source-version tuple." That is at-most-once-committed, and naming the idempotency key makes it a gate someone can actually write. It no longer contradicts PLAN:112's at-least-once clarification.

**R3 ? resolved.** PLAN:110: "Every due source ends with an explicit outcome, including blocked, access_pending and skipped_budget; skipped_budget must never be reported as checked." The honesty rule from PLAN:102 is now gated rather than prose.

**R4 ? resolved in both files, and matches what I verified in source.** CLAIMS C11 now states the API "inserts design.description and design.features while the generated EventPageDesign type contains reasoning and neither mapped field. Missing description violates NOT NULL; features needs a validated value or explicit empty-array default." That is exactly the state of `page-designer.ts:74-80` (`{id, theme, spec, reasoning, preview_image?}`), `design/route.ts:56-63`, and the migration's `description TEXT NOT NULL` with no default versus `features TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'`. PLAN:70 carries both fields plus "test the generated payload against the real NOT NULL constraints."

**R5 ? resolved.** The multi-provenance clause is gone from P02, and PLAN:84 places it where the data exists: "P03 extends P02's takedown acceptance to provenance: removing one disallowed source preserves independently permitted source records without silently restoring hidden content." P02 retains only what it can exercise ? report button, moderator hide/restore, cache invalidation, appeal path.

## No new findings

I reviewed each changed sentence for side effects. No scope was added or dropped, no invariant weakened, no acceptance loosened; PLAN:50 and PLAN:110 are both tightenings. G1 and G2 are now recorded `[x]` with builder-side evidence, and my independent reruns above match the expected tokens. G3/G4 remain `pending`, to be filled from this verdict ? that recording is outside what I reviewed and does not change the plan or the checks.

No blocking or major findings remain.
